interpretation_caveats: Persistence receives the observed label A(t); V4 and LR receive only features. Its accuracy is not achievable by a traffic model for free.
Only 6-14 transition windows exist per horizon; transition-conditioned numbers are descriptive and cannot support significance testing.
Windows inside one attack episode are temporally dependent — thousands of attack windows are not thousands of independent episodes.
